headline: Executive order creates a US government office focused on partnerships with Afghanistan and Pakistan and updates an older foreign aid order.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new federal office called the Afghanistan and Pakistan Strategic Partnership Office. It also changes Executive Order 12163, an older order that lays out how US foreign aid programs are run. The title does not explain the new office's exact duties, staffing, or budget.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle foreign aid and diplomacy
who_it_affects.how: They gain a new office tied to US work with Afghanistan and Pakistan and must follow updated rules from the changed foreign aid order.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations in Afghanistan and Pakistan who take part in US-supported programs
who_it_affects.how: US programs and partnerships in these countries may be organized or managed through the new office.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on January 17, 2014; the title does not state a date.
